trivy_raw_fail_entries.Description: Viewing secrets at the namespace scope can lead to escalation if another service account in that namespace has a higher privileged rolebinding or clusterrolebinding bound.
trivy_raw_fail_entries.Message: Role 'reader-role' shouldn't have access to manage secrets in namespace 'lab-c'
trivy_raw_fail_entries.Resolution: Manage namespace secrets are not allowed. Remove resource 'secrets' from role
